query:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT MAX(snapshot) AS snapshot_date
  FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
),
filtered_population AS (
  SELECT hp.ID AS id, hp.dependent_seq_no, hp.age, hl.region, ls.snapshot_date
  FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp
  JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.ID = hl.id
  CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls
  WHERE hp.is_in_population = TRUE
    AND hp.snapshot = ls.snapshot_date
    AND hp.age > 0
    AND hp.age <= 100
    AND TRIM(hl.region) != ''
    AND hl.region IS NOT NULL
),
population_age_region AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(region) AS region,
    snapshot_date,
    CASE
      WHEN age BETWEEN 0 AND 14 THEN '0-14'
      WHEN age BETWEEN 15 AND 24 THEN '15-24'
      WHEN age BETWEEN 25 AND 44 THEN '25-44'
      WHEN age BETWEEN 45 AND 64 THEN '45-64'
      WHEN age >= 65 THEN '65+'
    END AS age_group,
    id,
    dependent_seq_no
  FROM filtered_population
),
input AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    snapshot_date,
    age_group,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id, dependent_seq_no) AS population
  FROM population_age_region
  GROUP BY region, snapshot_date, age_group
  ORDER BY region, age_group
)
SELECT input.*, poly.wkt
FROM input
LEFT JOIN ESTISHRAF_LLM_KSA_Regions_Polygons poly
  ON regexp_replace(trim(input.region), '^(المنطقة|منطقة)\\s+', '') = regexp_replace(trim(poly.region), '^(المنطقة|منطقة)\\s+', '');
